english.title: Fail to ensure that the printing of tachograph records could be carried out on inspection other than no materials
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), failed to ensure that the printing of records could be carried out, correctly in the event of an inspection, other than by a failure to provide sufficient print material, namely **(..SPECIFY THE METHOD OF FAILURE..), in contravention of Article 14 of the Community Recording Equipment Regulation
english.legislation: Contrary to section 97(1)(a) of the Transport Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) Section 97(7) defines the "Community Recording Equipment Regulation" as Council Regulation (EEC ) No. 561/06, as amended.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) Where the failure is because of a failure to provide sufficient printing material - CJS Code TR68184 and H9596.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant failed to ensure that the printing of records in the event of an inspection could be carried out.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Fixed penalty ticket – Two hundred pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
